# Am I Cooked

> Am I Cooked is a free, open-source (MIT) MCP server that runs on a student's laptop and lets Claude Desktop, Claude Code or ChatGPT read their D2L Brightspace courses: grades, assignments and due dates, announcements, course content and files. Not affiliated with or endorsed by D2L or any university.

The student logs in to their school in a real browser window; Am I Cooked keeps the session locally in `~/.amicooked` and never sees their password. ChatGPT reaches the laptop through a private tunnel and needs developer mode. Setup has presets for Ontario Brightspace schools and accepts any Brightspace URL; it is tested at McMaster University. It reads courses and does not submit work.

## Install

- [SKILL.md](https://amicooked.app/SKILL.md): step-by-step setup instructions written for AI agents. Start here if a user asks you to set up Am I Cooked.
- macOS and Linux: `curl -fsSL https://amicooked.app/install.sh | sh`
- Windows (PowerShell): `irm https://amicooked.app/install.ps1 | iex`
- With Node.js: `npx -y amicooked setup`
- Uninstall: `amicooked uninstall`

## Tools

- `am_i_cooked`: overall heat score for the coming days, labelled raw, warming up, toasty, cooked or well done
- `get_my_grades`: current grades per course
- `get_assignments`: assignments and due dates
- `get_announcements`: course announcements
- `get_course_content`: course content tree (modules, topics, files)
- `download_file`: download a course file to the laptop
